newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil court rules against CEG, Riogas sale - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil court rules against CEG, Riogas sale - paper.

text.p: A Rio de Janeiro state court judge has granted an injunction against the privatization of state gas company CEG and piped gas distributor Riogas which are due to be sold off Monday on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange, a newspaper said.
The Rio state government is appealing the court ruling and has maintained the closed-envelope auction for 1000 local time/0900 EDT/1300 GMT, Jornal do Brasil said.
CEG is being sold at a minimum price of 423 million reais, while the base price for Riogas is 141 million reais.
Market sources said 25 companies grouped in six different consortia will take part in the first privatization auction of a state-owned gas company, Jornal do Brasil said.
Whoever places the highest combined bid for both companies will emerge as the winning bidder. Up to 10 million reais of the sale price can be paid for in privatization bonds.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
